decision_rule_fixed_here: SAME-FLIGHT NODE-TEMPLATE COLUMN READ AS THE VERDICT SOURCE OF THE VER-1 RULE (VER-1c; NX instrument E1/E2; owner decision 257, decision 258 option A proposed 2026-10-10; claim ceiling 'descriptive': the arm is NOT a nomination). One flight, one Solver visit per row of TRAIN Fold A, 3 arms over the SAME QueryState and evidence: r1-c3 (the R1 c3 template, the same hash-pinned bytes the NX R1 iteration-1 cell flew), aa (the twin, replicate_of lock) and lock (the locked template, delivering, last). Each arm's first-visit Solver answer is rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train per arm (never sharded; scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --mode supply-variants writes the per-arm first-visit outputs and scores the composer reads). READS: (1) THE TWIN NULL first: aa minus lock on every metric, paired per row, whole-utterance cluster bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260915), reported beside the E1 provisional floor (SLU-F1 1.49 pp, intent 0.65 pp at n = 1,080; borrowed until a node-column cell measures its own null). (2) THE c3 COLUMN: r1-c3 minus lock, pooled SLU-F1 and intent, quoted DESCRIPTIVELY with its CI95 (it gates nothing and nominates nothing; a Fold A c3 loss or gain is information about the verdict source, not a result of this cell). (3) THE VERDICT SOURCE: the c3 presence verdict is the flag 'the r1-c3 answer carried no entity after the registered v4g normaliser' (slurp_ver1_offline.verdict_flags); the number of verdict-empty rows and of verdict-empty rows on empty-gold rows is reported beside the TRAIN Fold B figures of the NX R1 flights so that a drift of the verdict between rosters is visible. (4) THE VER-1 RULE FIXED ON SLURP-EVO-FOLD-B-V2 (support filter n = 3, s = 2; c3 verdict x N1 >= 0.2; v4g) is applied offline to the VER-1b sample pool on these rows with scripts/analysis/slurp_ver1_offline.py --verdict-run; the confirmation criterion is the VER-1b READ row's (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VER1B-SAMPLES-FOLD-A-POOL-READ-V1). NOTHING IS TUNED OR SELECTED HERE. The delivering arm is the lock: the delivered answer is unchanged by construction at the request level (invariant I7).
development_numbers_only: Every number is a TRAIN Fold A development number (owner decisions 28 and 86), never a test claim.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. The budget is run-cumulative across attempts.
one_factor: the Solver instruction template (phase_material.solver.instruction_template) of the one non-delivering candidate arm: ONE hash-pinned path (configs/probes/nx/solver/r1/r1-c3.txt, the R1 c3 template) and nothing else (no supply knob, decoding, response format or tool authority); the base, the TRAIN Fold A pins, the review-off program and the module block are the instrument's carrier, shared by every arm
prohibitions: No test-split, DEV or TRAIN Fold B contact or read (the column is TRAIN Fold A; the rule was fixed on TRAIN Fold B).
No second factor: one axis (the Solver instruction template), none on aa or lock.
No tool schema on any role; no Reviewer or Planner visit; max_revisions 0.
No second candidate and no re-authored template: the arm is the R1 c3 template, byte for byte.
No v4 or v4g normaliser wired differently from lock v2.2's module cell (v4g at delivery); no other normaliser variant.
No benefit claim and no nomination: expected_effect_pp 0.0, claims_benefit false.
No flight before root countersigns the DRAFT rows, mints the decision receipt and the cells are flipped.
No arm score opened before the READ row is root countersigned.
